description: Create monster/recon.py (~2500 lines) - massively expanded reconnaissance engine with many new data sources and techniques.
steps: Create monster/recon.py (~2500 lines) with all of the following: ReconResults dataclass (domain, subdomains list, dns_records dict, wayback_urls list, google_dorks list, shodan_queries list, technologies list, ports list, asn_info dict, cloud_assets list, scan_time float), ReconEngine class with __init__(domain, output_dir, options) and run() method that orchestrates all recon tasks. Include these methods/features: (1) Subdomain enumeration from multiple sources - crt.sh, VirusTotal API, SecurityTrails API, HackerTarget, AlienVault OTX, ThreatCrowd, URLScan.io, Certificate Transparency logs, DNS brute force from wordlist, (2) ASN lookup - query for ASN info of target IP, enumerate IP ranges in ASN, (3) Reverse IP lookup - find other domains on same IP, (4) DNS zone transfer attempt - try AXFR against all NS servers, (5) DNS record enumeration - A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, SRV records for domain and discovered subdomains, (6) GitHub/GitLab dorking - generate search queries for leaked code/secrets, (7) S3 bucket enumeration - generate and check common bucket name patterns for target, (8) Cloud metadata detection - check for exposed cloud metadata endpoints on discovered hosts, (9) Favicon hash fingerprinting - download favicon, compute mmh3 hash, lookup against Shodan, (10) HTTP probe - probe all discovered subdomains for HTTP/HTTPS, get status code/title/server header/tech stack, (11) Screenshot URL generation - generate aquatone/gowitness compatible URL lists, (12) Virtual host discovery - try common vhost names against target IP, (13) Wayback Machine URL extraction, (14) Google dork generation using templates from config, (15) Shodan query generation, (16) Technology fingerprinting from headers/cookies/body patterns, (17) Port scanning of common ports, (18) WHOIS-like info extraction from DNS records, (19) Email security check (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), (20) Save all results to JSON and text files in output directory. Each source/technique should be its own method. Use ThreadPoolExecutor for parallel subdomain enumeration. Follow the existing pattern of using self.http (HTTPClient) for requests and self.file_manager (FileManager) for output.
Verify: python -c 'from monster.recon import ReconEngine, ReconResults; print("Recon OK")'
acceptance_criteria: ReconEngine class imports and instantiates correctly
All methods are defined and have proper docstrings
Follows existing pattern: uses HTTPClient, FileManager, ColorOutput from utils
verification: python -c 'from monster.recon import ReconEngine, ReconResults; e = ReconEngine("example.com", "/tmp/test", {"dry_run": True}); print("Recon engine OK")'
